title: Turizm va mehmondo‘stlik
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ekskursiyani aniq tuzilma bilan olib borasiz, joylar va tarixni to‘g‘ri zamon va majhul nisbat bilan tasvirlaysiz, shikoyatga uzr va yechim bilan javob berasiz hamda qo‘shimcha xizmatni bosimsiz taklif qilasiz.

scenes.title: Turizm va mehmondo‘stlik
board: Tourism and hospitality
Ekskursiya · joylar va tarix · xizmatni tiklash · taklif
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda marketing tilini o‘rgandik. Bugun turizm va mehmondo‘stlik olamiga kirasiz, bu yerda ingliz tilingiz real odamlar bilan uchrashadi: charchagan, qiziquvchan, xursand yoki norozi mehmonlar bilan. Dars oxirida siz ekskursiyani tartib bilan olib borasiz, joylar va tarixni tasvirlaysiz, noqulay vaziyatda mehmondan uzr so‘rab, muammoni hal qilasiz va qo‘shimcha xizmatni bosimsiz taklif qilasiz. Bu bo‘lim Britaniya va Amerika mehmonxonalarida ham, O‘zbekistondagi xalqaro turizmda ham kerak. Asosiy g‘oya: iliq, aniq va hurmatli ohang.
scenes.say: Hello and welcome. Last lesson was about marketing. Today we step into the world of tourism and hospitality, where your English meets real people: guests who are tired, curious, delighted or disappointed. You will guide, describe, apologise and recommend, all in professional English.
scenes.say_uz: Salom va xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan dars marketing haqida edi. Bugun turizm va mehmondo‘stlik olamiga kiramiz, bu yerda ingliz tilingiz haqiqiy odamlar bilan uchrashadi. Ekskursiya olib borasiz, tasvirlaysiz, uzr so‘raysiz va tavsiya qilasiz, hammasi professional ingliz tilida.

scenes.title: Ekskursiya olib borish
board: signposting: first · next · then · finally
On your left / right you will see…
We will be stopping for 10 minutes. Please mind the step.

examples.t: If you look to your right, you will see the old city gate.
examples.uz: O‘ng tomonga qarasangiz, eski shahar darvozasini ko‘rasiz.

examples.t: We will now walk for ten minutes, so please stay together.
examples.uz: Endi o‘n daqiqa piyoda yuramiz, iltimos, birga yuring.

examples.t: Feel free to take photos, but please do not touch the walls.
examples.uz: Rasmga olishingiz mumkin, lekin iltimos, devorlarga tegmang.

scenes.say_native: Yaxshi gid tuzilma, yo‘nalish va mayin ko‘rsatma beradi. Avval ekskursiyada nima borligini va qancha davom etishini ayting: „This tour includes three stops and takes about ninety minutes.“ Har bosqichni belgilang: „first“, „next“, „finally“. Diqqatni yo‘naltirish uchun „on your left you will see“ yoki „if you look up, you will notice“. Reja uchun „will“, ko‘rsatma uchun „please“ ishlating: „please stay together“. To‘xtash davomiyligini ayting: „we will be stopping for ten minutes“. Muhim xavfsizlik qoidasini bir marta, aniq takrorlang. Buyruq o‘rniga iltimos shaklini tanlang, shunda guruh bosim sezmaydi.
scenes.say: A good guide gives structure, directions and gentle instructions. Start by saying what the tour includes and how long it takes. Signpost each stage: first, next, finally. Direct attention with on your left you will see. Use will for the plan, and please for instructions. Say how long a stop lasts, then repeat important safety points once.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi gid tuzilma, yo‘nalish va mayin ko‘rsatma beradi. Avval ekskursiya nimani qamrashini va qancha davom etishini ayting. Har bosqichni first, next, finally bilan belgilang. Diqqatni on your left you will see bilan yo‘naltiring. Reja uchun will, ko‘rsatma uchun please ishlating.

scenes.title: Xato: buyruq ohangi
board: ✗ Come here! Don’t go there!
✓ Could everyone gather here, please?
✓ Please avoid the roped-off area

examples.t: Could I ask you to keep to the path, please?
examples.uz: Iltimos, yo‘ldan chiqmasligingizni so‘rasam bo‘ladimi?

examples.t: We are meeting back here at half past eleven.
examples.uz: Soat o‘n bir yarimda yana shu yerda uchrashamiz.

scenes.say_native: Yalang‘och buyruq mehmonga qo‘pol eshitiladi. „Come here!“ o‘rniga „Could everyone gather here, please?“ deng. Taqiqlashda ham nima qilmaslik emas, nima qilish kerakligini ayting: „Please keep to the path“ — „don’t walk on the grass“ dan yumshoqroq. O‘zbek tilida „keling“ deyish odatiy, inglizchada esa mehmon bilan professional munosabatda iltimos shakli kerak. Ikkinchi tuzoq — vaqt predloglari: soat oldidan „at“, kun oldidan „on“, kun qismi oldidan „in“: „at half past eleven“, „on Tuesday“, „in the morning“. Uchrashuv joyi va vaqtini birga ayting, shunda hech kim adashmaydi.
scenes.say: Bare commands sound rude to guests. Compare come here with could everyone gather here, please. For prohibitions, state what to do instead of only what not to do: please keep to the path. A second trap is the preposition with time. We meet at half past eleven, but on Tuesday and in the morning. State the meeting point and the time together so no one is lost.
scenes.say_uz: Yalang‘och buyruqlar mehmonga qo‘pol eshitiladi. Come here o‘rniga could everyone gather here, please deng. Taqiqlashda nima qilish kerakligini ayting. Vaqt predloglarini ham eslang: soat oldida at, kun oldida on, kun qismi oldida in. Uchrashuv joyi va vaqtini birga ayting.

scenes.title: Mashq: ko‘rsatma bering
board: 1) Ask the group to stay together
2) Tell them to meet at 3 p.m. at the fountain
3) Announce a ten-minute stop
scenes.say_native: Tur guruhiga uchta muloyim ko‘rsatma bering. Birinchisi: guruhdan birga yurishni so‘rang. Ikkinchisi: soat uchda favvora oldida yana uchrashishni ayting. Uchinchisi: surat olish uchun o‘n daqiqa to‘xtashni e’lon qiling. Har birida „please“ yoki „could“ ishlating, soat uchun „at“ ni to‘g‘ri qo‘ying. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Give three polite instructions to a tour group. One: ask the group to stay together. Two: tell them to meet back at the fountain at three o'clock. Three: announce that you will stop for ten minutes for photographs.
scenes.say_uz: Tur guruhiga uchta muloyim ko‘rsatma bering. Guruhdan birga yurishni so‘rang. Soat uchda favvora oldida yana uchrashishni ayting. Surat uchun o‘n daqiqa to‘xtashni e’lon qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ko‘rsatmalar
board: Could everyone stay together, please?
Let us meet at the fountain at three o’clock.
We will stop here for ten minutes for photos.

examples.t: Could everyone stay together, please?
examples.uz: Hamma birga yursa bo‘ladimi, iltimos?

scenes.say_native: Mumkin javoblar: „Could everyone stay together, please?“ Soat uchda favvora oldida yana uchrashamiz: „Let us meet back at the fountain at three o’clock.“ Va „We will stop here for ten minutes, so do take some photographs“ — „do take“ dagi „do“ taklifni quvnoqroq qiladi. Har bir gap muloyim, aniq va bitta ma’lumot beradi. Uchta ko‘rsatmani bitta uzun gapga jamlamang: mehmonlar eshitib ulgurmaydi, ayniqsa shovqinli ko‘chada. Qisqa gap — yaxshi gidning belgisi.
scenes.say: Possible answers. Could everyone stay together, please? Let us meet back at the fountain at three o'clock. We will stop here for ten minutes, so do take some photographs. Each one is polite, clear and gives only one piece of information. Avoid packing three instructions into one long sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin javoblar. Hamma birga yursa bo‘ladimi, iltimos? Soat uchda favvora oldida yana uchrashamiz. Bu yerda o‘n daqiqa to‘xtaymiz, shuning uchun rasmga oling. Har bir gap muloyim, aniq va bitta ma’lumot beradi.

scenes.title: Joylar va tarixni tasvirlash
board: dates back to · was built in · was founded by
is known for · is famous for · is renowned for
stands · lies · overlooks · is located

examples.t: The fortress dates back to the twelfth century.
examples.uz: Qal’a XII asrga borib taqaladi.

examples.t: The mosque was built in 1404 and restored in the 1990s.
examples.uz: Masjid 1404 yilda qurilgan va 1990-yillarda ta’mirlangan.

examples.t: The old town is renowned for its narrow streets and lively bazaar.
examples.uz: Eski shahar tor ko‘chalari va jonli bozori bilan mashhur.

scenes.say_native: Joy haqidagi faktlar hozirgi oddiy zamonda: „the old town is renowned for its bazaar“. Tarix o‘tgan zamonda, ko‘pincha majhul nisbatda: „was built“, „was founded“, „was restored“. Yoshni ko‘rsatish uchun „dates back to the twelfth century“ — „XII asrga borib taqaladi“. Shuhrat uchun „is known for“, „is famous for“, „is renowned for“. Joylashuv uchun „stands“, „lies“, „overlooks“. Asrlarni tartib son bilan aytamiz: „the fifteenth century“. Bitta sezgi tafsiloti qo‘shing: ovoz, rang, hid. Shunda mehmon manzarani ko‘z oldiga keltiradi. O‘zbek tilida ham „qurilgan“ deymiz, inglizchada esa „was built“ da „by whom“ ko‘pincha kerak emas.
scenes.say: Facts about places use the present simple. History uses the past, often the passive: was built, was founded, was restored. To show age, say dates back to the twelfth century. For reputation, use is known for or is renowned for. For position, use stands, lies, overlooks. Add one sensory detail, so the guests can picture it.
scenes.say_uz: Joy haqidagi faktlar hozirgi oddiy zamonda. Tarix o‘tgan zamonda, ko‘pincha majhul nisbatda: was built, was founded, was restored. Yosh uchun dates back to, shuhrat uchun is known for yoki is renowned for, joylashuv uchun stands, lies, overlooks. Mehmon ko‘z oldiga keltirishi uchun bitta sezgi tafsilotini qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Xato: zamon va fe’l shakli
board: ✗ The mosque built in 1404
✓ The mosque was built in 1404
✗ It dates from back to the 12th century

examples.t: The palace was designed by a local architect.
examples.uz: Saroyni mahalliy me’mor loyihalagan.

examples.t: Many tourists visit the square every year.
examples.uz: Har yili ko‘p sayyoh maydonga tashrif buyuradi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkita odatiy xato. Birinchisi: majhul nisbatda „was“ tushib qoladi. „The mosque built in 1404“ noto‘g‘ri, „was built“ kerak. O‘zbek tilida „1404 yilda qurilgan“ deymiz va yordamchi fe’l kerak emas, inglizchada esa majhul nisbat „be + III shakl“ talab qiladi. Ikkinchisi: qotgan ibora „dates back to“, ichida „from“ yo‘q. Raqamlarga ham e’tibor bering: yilni „nineteen ninety“ deb o‘qiymiz, „one thousand nine hundred ninety“ emas. Asr tartib sonda: „the fifteenth century“, „the fifteen century“ emas. Gidning raqamni to‘g‘ri aytishi ishonch uyg‘otadi.
scenes.say: Two typical errors. First, learners leave out was in the passive: the mosque built in 1404 is wrong. We need was built. Second, the fixed phrase is dates back to, with no from. Also take care with numbers: say in nineteen ninety, not one thousand nine hundred ninety, and use the fifteenth century, not the fifteen century.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita odatiy xato. Majhul nisbatda was tushib qoladi: was built kerak. Qotgan ibora dates back to, from ishlatilmaydi. Raqamlarga ham e’tibor bering: yilni nineteen ninety deb o‘qiymiz, asr esa tartib sonda: the fifteenth century.

scenes.title: Mashq: joyni tasvirlang
board: 1) A castle, 11th century, on a hill
2) A market, famous for spices
3) A bridge, built in 1890, restored recently
scenes.say_native: Uchta joyni bittadan gap bilan tasvirlang. Birinchisi: tepalikdagi XI asr qal’asi. Ikkinchisi: ziravorlari bilan mashhur bozor. Uchinchisi: 1890 yilda qurilgan va yaqinda ta’mirlangan ko‘prik. „Dates back to“, „is renowned for“ va majhul nisbatni ishlating. Yilni to‘g‘ri o‘qing: eighteen ninety.
scenes.say: Describe three places in one sentence each. A castle from the eleventh century on a hill. A market that is famous for its spices. A bridge that was built in eighteen ninety and restored recently. Use dates back to, is renowned for and the passive.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta joyni bittadan gap bilan tasvirlang. Tepalikdagi XI asr qal’asi. Ziravorlari bilan mashhur bozor. 1890 yilda qurilgan va yaqinda ta’mirlangan ko‘prik.

scenes.title: Javoblar: joylar
board: The castle dates back to the eleventh century.
The market is renowned for its spices.
The bridge was built in 1890 and recently restored.

examples.t: The castle overlooks the valley from a hill and dates back to the eleventh century.
examples.uz: Qal’a tepalikdan vodiyga qarab turadi va XI asrga borib taqaladi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar: „The castle stands on a hill and dates back to the eleventh century.“ „The market is renowned for its spices, and you can smell cardamom from the entrance“ — bu yerda hid tafsiloti bor. „The bridge was built in eighteen ninety and was recently restored.“ Ikki majhul fe’lni „and“ bilan bog‘ladik. „Recently“ ni „was“ dan keyin qo‘yish tabiiy. Siz boshqa so‘zlar tanlagan bo‘lsangiz ham, uchta shartni tekshiring: yoshni ko‘rsatdingizmi, shuhratni aytdingizmi, majhul nisbat to‘g‘ri kelganmi.
scenes.say: Model answers. The castle stands on a hill and dates back to the eleventh century. The market is renowned for its spices, and you can smell cardamom from the entrance. The bridge was built in eighteen ninety and was recently restored. Notice the sensory detail in the market sentence, and the double passive with and.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblar. Qal’a tepalikda turadi va XI asrga borib taqaladi. Bozor ziravorlari bilan mashhur, kirish joyidan kardamon hidini sezasiz. Ko‘prik 1890 yilda qurilgan va yaqinda ta’mirlangan. Bozor gapida hid tafsiloti bor.

scenes.title: Xizmatni tiklash
board: 1 Listen · 2 Apologise · 3 Solve · 4 Follow up
I am very sorry about that.
Let me put that right. · as a gesture of goodwill

examples.t: I am so sorry about the noise. Let me move you to a quieter room.
examples.uz: Shovqin uchun juda uzr. Sizni tinchroq xonaga ko‘chiray.

examples.t: I completely understand why you are upset.
examples.uz: Nega xafa ekaningizni to‘liq tushunaman.

examples.t: The dessert is on the house, as a gesture of goodwill.
examples.uz: Desert hisobdan, yaxshi niyat ishorasi sifatida.

scenes.say_native: Xizmatni tiklash — shikoyatni sodiqlikka aylantirish san’ati. To‘rt qadam. Birinchi: gapini bo‘lmasdan tinglang. Ikkinchi: samimiy uzr so‘rang: „I am very sorry about that.“ Uchinchi: aniq harakat bilan hal qiling: „Let me put that right“ — buni to‘g‘rilab beray, va amalda: „Let me move you to another room.“ To‘rtinchi: keyin qo‘ng‘iroq qilib yoki so‘rab, mehmon mamnunligini tekshiring. Kompensatsiya, masalan „complimentary“ ya’ni bepul yoki „on the house“ — hisobdan, yaxshi niyat belgisi, lekin uzr va yechimdan keyin. Hamdardlik so‘zlari: „I completely understand why you are upset.“ Bu mehmonga eshitilganini bildiradi.
scenes.say: Service recovery turns a complaint into loyalty. Follow four steps. Listen without interrupting. Apologise sincerely: I am very sorry about that. Solve the problem with a concrete action: let me put that right. Then follow up to check the guest is satisfied. Compensation, such as complimentary dessert or on the house, shows goodwill, but only after the apology and the solution.
scenes.say_uz: Xizmatni tiklash shikoyatni sodiqlikka aylantiradi. To‘rt qadam: tinglang, samimiy uzr so‘rang, aniq harakat bilan hal qiling, keyin mamnunlikni tekshiring. Kompensatsiya, masalan bepul desert yoki on the house, yaxshi niyatni ko‘rsatadi, lekin uzr va yechimdan keyin keladi.

scenes.title: Xato: oqlanish va ayblash
board: ✗ It is not my fault, the kitchen was busy
✓ I apologise for the delay. Let me check on your order.
✗ You must wait

examples.t: Unfortunately, that table is booked, but I can offer you the terrace.
examples.uz: Afsuski, u stol band, lekin sizga ayvonni taklif qila olaman.

examples.t: Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
examples.uz: Buni e’tiborimizga havola qilganingiz uchun rahmat.

scenes.say_native: Himoyalanmang va hamkasbni ayblamang. „It is not my fault, the kitchen was busy“ mehmonni e’tiborsiz qoldirilgandek his qildiradi. „You must wait“ ham qo‘pol. Nima qila olishingizni ayting: „Let me check“, „I can offer you“. „Unfortunately“ ni faqat cheklovni aytishda ishlating va darrov muqobil bering: „Unfortunately, that table is booked, but I can offer you the terrace.“ Fikr uchun rahmat ayting: „Thank you for bringing this to our attention.“ „I apologise for the inconvenience“ — muloyim ibora, lekin takrorlansa, yodlangan matndek eshitiladi, shuning uchun tabiiy variantlar bilan almashtiring.
scenes.say: Do not defend yourself or blame colleagues. It is not my fault makes the guest feel ignored. Do not say you must wait, either. Say what you can do: let me check, I can offer. Use unfortunately only to introduce a limit, and follow it at once with an alternative. And thank the guest for the feedback. Remember that I apologise for the inconvenience is polite but can sound scripted if repeated.
scenes.say_uz: Himoyalanmang va hamkasbni ayblamang. Mehmonga nima qila olishingizni ayting. Unfortunately so‘zini faqat cheklovni aytishda ishlating va darrov muqobil bering. Fikr uchun rahmat ayting. I apologise for the inconvenience takrorlansa, yodlangan matndek eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Mashq: shikoyatga javob
board: Guest: My room is next to a building site.
Guest: We waited an hour for our food.
Use: apologise + solve + goodwill
scenes.say_native: Ikki shikoyatga javob bering. Birinchi mehmon: xonam qurilish maydoni yonida va juda shovqinli. Ikkinchi mehmon: ovqatni bir soat kutdik. Har bir javobda uzr so‘rang va aniq yechim taklif qiling, ikkinchisida yaxshi niyat ishorasini ham qo‘shing. Oqlanmang, ayblamang. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Respond to two complaints. A guest says: my room is next to a building site, and it is very noisy. Another says: we waited an hour for our food. In each reply, apologise, propose a concrete solution and, for the second, offer a gesture of goodwill.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki shikoyatga javob bering. Mehmon: xonam qurilish maydoni yonida va shovqinli. Boshqa mehmon: ovqatni bir soat kutdik. Uzr so‘rang, aniq yechim taklif qiling, ikkinchisida yaxshi niyat ishorasini qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javoblar: shikoyatlar
board: I am so sorry. Let me move you to a quiet room.
I apologise for the wait. Dessert is on the house.

examples.t: I am so sorry about the noise. Let me move you to a quieter room at the back.
examples.uz: Shovqin uchun juda uzr. Sizni orqadagi tinchroq xonaga ko‘chiray.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: „I am so sorry about the noise. Let me move you to a quieter room at the back, and I will have your luggage taken up.“ Ikkinchi: „I apologise for the long wait. Your main courses are on the house, and I will make sure the kitchen prioritises your table.“ Tartibga qarang: avval uzr, keyin yechim, keyin kompensatsiya. „I will have your luggage taken up“ — „have something done“ qolipi: yukingiz yuqoriga olib chiqilishini tashkil qilaman. Mehmon uchun muhimi: javobda uning muammosi hal bo‘layotgani aniq eshitilsin.
scenes.say: Model replies. I am so sorry about the noise. Let me move you to a quieter room at the back, and I will have your luggage taken up. And: I apologise for the long wait. Your main courses are on the house, and I will make sure the kitchen prioritises your table. The replies apologise, solve and then compensate, in that order.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblar. Shovqin uchun juda uzr, sizni orqadagi tinchroq xonaga ko‘chiraman va yukingizni olib chiqtiraman. Uzoq kutish uchun uzr, asosiy taomlar hisobdan va oshxona stolingizni birinchi o‘ringa qo‘yishiga ishonch hosil qilaman. Tartib: uzr, yechim, kompensatsiya.

scenes.title: Muloyim qo‘shimcha taklif
board: Would you like to upgrade to…?
For just £20 more, you could enjoy…
May I suggest… · Many of our guests enjoy…

examples.t: For just twenty pounds more, you could have a room with a sea view.
examples.uz: Atigi yigirma funt qo‘shsangiz, dengiz ko‘rinadigan xonaga ega bo‘lishingiz mumkin.

examples.t: May I suggest our tasting menu? Many guests find it excellent value.
examples.uz: Degustatsiya menyusini tavsiya qilsam bo‘ladimi? Ko‘p mehmonlar uni juda foydali deb hisoblaydi.

examples.t: Of course, no problem at all. The standard room is lovely too.
examples.uz: Albatta, hech qanday muammo yo‘q. Oddiy xona ham juda yoqimli.

scenes.say_native: Qo‘shimcha taklif mehmonga foyda bersa ishlaydi. Ehtiyojdan boshlang, keyin narxni emas, foydani taklif qiling. Yumshoq qoliplar: „Would you like to upgrade to…?“, „May I suggest…?“, „you could enjoy…“. Aniq sabab bering: „For just twenty pounds more, you could have a sea view.“ „Many of our guests enjoy“ — ijtimoiy dalil, ya’ni boshqalar tanlagani, bosimsiz ishontiradi. Taklif qiling, lekin majburlamang. Mehmon rad etsa, chiroyli qabul qiling: „Of course, no problem at all.“ Shunda u keyingi safar ham sizni tinglaydi. Narxni to‘g‘ri ayting: bir martalik va kecha uchun narx farqini aniq ko‘rsating.
scenes.say: Upselling works when it helps the guest. Start from a need, then offer a benefit, not just a price. Use soft frames: would you like to, may I suggest, you could enjoy. Give a clear reason: for just twenty pounds more, you could have a sea view. Offer, never push. If the guest declines, accept gracefully: of course, no problem at all.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘shimcha taklif mehmonga foyda bersa ishlaydi. Ehtiyojdan boshlang, keyin foydani taklif qiling. Yumshoq qoliplar: would you like to, may I suggest, you could enjoy. Aniq sabab bering. Taklif qiling, lekin majburlamang. Mehmon rad etsa, chiroyli qabul qiling.

scenes.title: Xato: bosim va grammatik tuzoqlar
board: ✗ You should buy the premium package
✓ Would you like to upgrade to the premium package?
✗ Do you want upgrade?

examples.t: Would you be interested in adding breakfast for ten euros?
examples.uz: O‘n yevroga nonushta qo‘shishga qiziqasizmi?

examples.t: If you prefer, I can leave it as it is.
examples.uz: Xohlasangiz, hammasini o‘z holicha qoldiraman.

scenes.say_native: Bosim so‘zlaridan qoching: „should“, „must“, „have to“. „You should buy the premium package“ — buyruqdek eshitiladi. „Do you want upgrade?“ grammatik noto‘g‘ri: „upgrade to something“ yoki „would you like an upgrade?“ deymiz. „Would you like“ dan keyin „to + fe’l“ yoki ot birikmasi keladi: „would you like to upgrade“, „would you like a late checkout?“. O‘zbek tilida „xohlaysizmi?“ deyishimiz mumkin, inglizchada esa „would you like“ ancha muloyim. Bir vaqtda juda ko‘p qo‘shimcha taklif qilmang: tanlov ko‘payganda bosimga aylanadi. Bitta puxta tanlangan taklif beshtadan kuchliroq.
scenes.say: Avoid pressure words like should, must and have to. Do you want upgrade is ungrammatical: we say upgrade to something, or would you like an upgrade. After would you like, use to plus a verb, or a noun phrase. Do not offer too many extras at once, since choice becomes pressure. One well-chosen suggestion is more effective than five.
scenes.say_uz: Should, must, have to kabi bosim so‘zlaridan qoching. Do you want upgrade noto‘g‘ri: upgrade to something yoki would you like an upgrade deymiz. Would you like dan keyin to plus fe’l yoki ot birikmasi keladi. Juda ko‘p taklif bosimga aylanadi: bitta puxta taklif beshtadan kuchliroq.

scenes.title: Mashq: taklif tuzing
board: 1) Offer a late checkout
2) Offer a dessert to a couple finishing dinner
3) Accept a "no" politely
scenes.say_native: Uchta muloyim taklif tuzing. Birinchisi: mehmonga kech chiqib ketish imkonini sababi bilan taklif qiling. Ikkinchisi: ovqatni tugatayotgan juftlikka desert taklif qiling. Uchinchisi: mehmon „yo‘q, rahmat“ desa, muloyim javob bering. „Would you like to“ va „may I suggest“ ni ishlating, bosim so‘zlarini ishlatmang.
scenes.say: Make three polite offers. One: offer a guest a late checkout, giving a reason. Two: offer a couple a dessert as they finish their meal. Three: respond politely when a guest says no thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta muloyim taklif tuzing. Mehmonga kech chiqib ketishni sababi bilan taklif qiling. Ovqatni tugatayotgan juftlikka desert taklif qiling. Mehmon yo‘q, rahmat desa, muloyim javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: takliflar
board: Would you like a late checkout? Your flight is in the evening.
May I suggest our chocolate tart?
Of course, no problem at all.

examples.t: May I suggest our chocolate tart? It is a favourite with our guests.
examples.uz: Shokoladli tartni tavsiya qilsam bo‘ladimi? Mehmonlarimiz uni yaxshi ko‘radi.

scenes.say_native: Mumkin takliflar: „Would you like a late checkout until two o’clock? I noticed your flight is in the evening.“ — taklif ehtiyojga bog‘langan, mehmonning parvozi kechqurun. Juftlik uchun: „May I suggest our chocolate tart? It is a favourite with our guests.“ Rad etilsa: „Of course, no problem at all. Please let me know if you change your mind.“ Har bir taklif ehtiyojga bog‘lanadi va tanlovni mehmonga qoldiradi. „I noticed“ iborasi mehmonga e’tibor berayotganingizni ko‘rsatadi. Bu savdo emas, xizmat kabi eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Possible offers. Would you like a late checkout until two o'clock? I noticed your flight is in the evening. For the couple: May I suggest our chocolate tart? It is a favourite with our guests. And when a guest declines: Of course, no problem at all. Please let me know if you change your mind. Each offer links to a need and leaves the choice open.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin takliflar. Soat ikkigacha kech chiqishni xohlaysizmi? Parvozingiz kechqurun ekanini payqadim. Juftlik uchun: shokoladli tartni tavsiya qilsam bo‘ladimi? Rad etilsa: albatta, hech qanday muammo yo‘q, fikringiz o‘zgarsa, ayting.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: shahar bo‘ylab tur
board: Guide: First, we are standing in the old square.
Guest: How old is the clock tower?
Guide: It dates back to 1887.
Guide: We will stop for coffee in ten minutes.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang. Gid guruhga murojaat qiladi: avval biz eski maydondamiz, u juma bozori bilan mashhur. Iltimos, soat minorasiga qarang: u 1887 yilda qurilgan va hamon aniq ishlaydi. Mehmon so‘raydi: u tashrif uchun ochiqmi? Gid: bugun yo‘q, afsuski, lekin o‘n daqiqadan keyin qahva uchun to‘xtaymiz. Eshiting: „first“ bilan boshlanish, „is renowned for“, „was built in“, „I am afraid“ — yumshoq rad, keyin darrov muqobil.
scenes.say: Good morning, everyone. First, we are standing in the old square, which is renowned for its Friday market. Please look up at the clock tower. It was built in eighteen eighty-seven and still keeps perfect time. Is it open to visitors? Not today, I am afraid, but we will stop for coffee in ten minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Hammaga xayrli tong. Avval biz eski maydondamiz, u juma bozori bilan mashhur. Iltimos, soat minorasiga qarang. U 1887 yilda qurilgan va hamon aniq ishlaydi. Tashrif uchun ochiqmi? Bugun yo‘q, afsuski, lekin o‘n daqiqadan keyin qahva uchun to‘xtaymiz.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What is the square known for?
2) When was the tower built?
3) Can the guests go inside?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Eski maydon nima bilan mashhur? Soat minorasi qachon qurilgan? Mehmonlar bugun minora ichiga kira oladimi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting va tarixiy fakt uchun to‘g‘ri zamonni tanlang.
scenes.say: Three questions. What is the old square renowned for? When was the clock tower built? And can the guests go inside the tower today?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Eski maydon nima bilan mashhur? Soat minorasi qachon qurilgan? Mehmonlar bugun minora ichiga kira oladimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
board: Friday market
built in 1887
not today; coffee stop instead
scenes.say_native: Maydon juma bozori bilan mashhur: „is renowned for its Friday market“. Minora 1887 yilda qurilgan: „was built in eighteen eighty-seven“, majhul nisbat, o‘tgan zamon. Mehmonlar bugun ichkariga kira olmaydi, lekin gid muqobil taklif qiladi: o‘n daqiqadan keyin qahva uchun to‘xtash. Rad etishning yumshatilishiga e’tibor bering: „I am afraid“ iborasi va undan keyingi ijobiy taklif. Bu tur gidligida ham, mehmonxonada ham ishlaydi: yo‘q deganingizda ham, nima mumkinligini ayting.
scenes.say: The square is renowned for its Friday market. The tower was built in eighteen eighty-seven. The guests cannot go inside today, but the guide offers an alternative: a coffee stop in ten minutes. Notice how a refusal is softened with I am afraid and followed by something positive.
scenes.say_uz: Maydon juma bozori bilan mashhur. Minora 1887 yilda qurilgan. Mehmonlar bugun ichkariga kira olmaydi, lekin gid muqobil taklif qiladi: qahva uchun to‘xtash. Rad I am afraid bilan yumshatilgan va ijobiy narsa bilan davom etgan.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: mehmonxona qabulxonasi
board: Guest: The air conditioning is broken in my room.
Staff: I am very sorry. Let me move you now.
Staff: For just fifteen pounds more, you could have a balcony.
Guest: Thanks, but the new room is fine.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat — mehmonxona qabulxonasi. Mehmon aytadi: xonamda konditsioner buzilgan. Xodim: bu uchun juda uzr, xonim, sizni darrov boshqa xonaga ko‘chiraman. Keyin yumshoq taklif: balkonli xona bor, kechasiga o‘n besh funt qimmat, xohlasangiz. Mehmon: rahmat, oddiy xona yetarli. Xodim: albatta, hech qanday muammo yo‘q. Ko‘ring: avval uzr va yechim, faqat undan keyin taklif, rad qilinganda esa bosimsiz qabul.
scenes.say: Reception, how can I help? The air conditioning in my room has stopped working. I am very sorry about that, madam. Let me move you to another room right away. There is a room with a balcony, which is fifteen pounds more per night if you would like it. Thank you, but a standard room is fine. Of course, no problem at all.
scenes.say_uz: Qabulxona, qanday yordam bera olaman? Xonamdagi konditsioner ishlamay qoldi. Bu uchun juda uzr, xonim. Sizni hoziroq boshqa xonaga ko‘chiray. Balkonli xona ham bor, xohlasangiz, kechasiga o‘n besh funt qimmatroq. Rahmat, lekin oddiy xona yaxshi. Albatta, hech qanday muammo yo‘q.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What is the problem?
2) What does the staff member do first?
3) Does the guest accept the upgrade?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat bo‘yicha savollar. Mehmon xonasidagi muammo nima? Xodim qo‘shimcha narsa taklif qilishdan oldin avval nima qiladi? Mehmon yangilanishni qabul qiladimi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Questions on the second conversation. What is the problem in the guest's room? What does the staff member do first, before offering anything extra? And does the guest accept the upgrade?
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi suhbat bo‘yicha savollar. Muammo nima? Xodim qo‘shimcha taklifdan oldin avval nima qiladi? Mehmon yangilanishni qabul qiladimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
board: air conditioning broken
apologises and moves the guest
declines; staff accepts gracefully
scenes.say_native: Muammo: mehmon xonasidagi konditsioner buzilgan. Xodim avval uzr so‘raydi va darrov ko‘chirishni taklif qiladi, faqat shundan keyin balkonli xonani eslatadi. Mehmon yangilanishni rad etadi, xodim buni chiroyli qabul qiladi. Asosiy dars tartibda: avval xizmatni tiklash, keyin qo‘shimcha taklif. Agar tartib teskari bo‘lsa, mehmon sizni muammodan foyda qidirayotgan deb o‘ylaydi. Shuning uchun norozi mehmonga hech qachon darrov narx haqida gapirmang.
scenes.say: The air conditioning in the guest's room is broken. The staff member apologises and offers to move the guest at once, and only then mentions the balcony room. The guest declines the upgrade, and the staff member accepts that gracefully. The order of recovery first, upsell second, is the key lesson.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmon xonasidagi konditsioner buzilgan. Xodim uzr so‘raydi va darrov ko‘chirishni taklif qiladi, faqat shundan keyin balkonli xonani eslatadi. Mehmon rad etadi, xodim chiroyli qabul qiladi. Tartib muhim: avval tiklash, keyin taklif.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: mini-ekskursiya
board: Choose a place in your city
Welcome + signposting
One historical fact + one tip or offer
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Shahringizdagi bitta diqqatga sazovor joyni tanlang va gid sifatida qisqa salomlashing. Bu qanday joy ekanini ayting, to‘g‘ri zamonda bitta tarixiy fakt keltiring, bitta muloyim ko‘rsatma bering va yaqin atrofdagi kafe kabi do‘stona taklif bilan yakunlang. Gapiring, keyin namuna bilan solishtiring.
scenes.say: Final task. Choose a landmark in your city and give a short welcome as a guide. Say what the stop is, give one historical fact in the correct tense, give one polite instruction, and end with a friendly offer, such as a nearby café.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Shahringizdagi diqqatga sazovor joyni tanlang va gid sifatida qisqa salomlashing. Tarixiy fakt keltiring, bitta muloyim ko‘rsatma bering va do‘stona taklif bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: Namuna mini-ekskursiya
board: Welcome · stop · fact · instruction · offer

examples.t: Welcome to the Registan, in the heart of Samarkand.
examples.uz: Samarqand yuragidagi Registonga xush kelibsiz.

scenes.say_native: Namuna: „Welcome to the Registan, in the heart of Samarkand.“ Keyin tuzilma: „First, look at the three madrasas“ — birinchi bosqich. „The oldest dates back to the fifteenth century“ — tarixiy fakt. „Please keep to the marked path“ — muloyim ko‘rsatma. Oxirida do‘stona taklif: yaqin atrofdagi choyxonani tavsiya qilaman. Siz o‘z joyingizni tanlagan bo‘lsangiz ham, shu beshta element bo‘lishi kerak: salomlashish, joy, fakt, ko‘rsatma, taklif. Qisqa va aniq bo‘ling, uzun yodlangan matn emas, suhbatdek tabiiy ohang kerak.
scenes.say: Welcome to the Registan, in the heart of Samarkand. First, look at the three madrasas facing each other across the square. The oldest dates back to the fifteenth century. Please keep to the marked path, and when we finish, I can recommend a tea house just around the corner.
scenes.say_uz: Samarqand yuragidagi Registonga xush kelibsiz. Avval maydon bo‘ylab bir-biriga qaragan uchta madrasaga qarang. Eng qadimiysi XV asrga borib taqaladi. Iltimos, belgilangan yo‘ldan chiqmang. Tugagach, yaqin atrofdagi choyxonani tavsiya qila olaman.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
board: signposting · please · could
dates back to · was built · is renowned for
listen · apologise · solve · follow up
would you like · may I suggest
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: gid ekskursiyani tuzadi va muloyim ko‘rsatma beradi, „first“, „next“, „please“, „could“. Ikkinchi: faktlar hozirgi zamonda, tarix o‘tgan zamonda va ko‘pincha majhul nisbatda: „dates back to“, „was built“, „is renowned for“. Uchinchi: xizmatni tiklash — tinglash, uzr so‘rash, hal qilish va keyin mamnunlikni tekshirish. To‘rtinchi: qo‘shimcha taklif ehtiyojdan boshlanadi va tanlovni mehmonga qoldiradi. Bu turizmdagi professional inglizcha muloqotning asosi.
scenes.say: Let us review. A guide structures the tour and gives polite instructions. Facts use the present, history uses the past and often the passive. Service recovery means listening, apologising, solving and following up. And upselling begins with a need and always leaves the choice to the guest.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. Gid ekskursiyani tuzadi va muloyim ko‘rsatma beradi. Faktlar hozirgi zamonda, tarix o‘tgan zamonda va ko‘pincha majhul nisbatda. Xizmatni tiklash tinglash, uzr, yechim va keyingi tekshiruvdan iborat. Qo‘shimcha taklif ehtiyojdan boshlanadi va tanlovni mehmonga qoldiradi.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Record a 3-minute tour of your city
3 stops · 1 fact each · 1 instruction · 1 offer
Success: clear order, correct tenses, warm tone
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: shahringiz bo‘ylab uch daqiqalik ekskursiyani yozib oling. Kamida uchta to‘xtash joyi bo‘lsin, har biri uchun bitta tarixiy fakt, bitta muloyim ko‘rsatma va do‘stona taklif. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: tartib aniq, zamonlar to‘g‘ri va ohang iliq bo‘lsa. Keyingi darsda o‘zbek va ingliz tillari o‘rtasidagi tarjima asoslarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to record a three-minute tour of your city. Include at least three stops, one historical fact for each, a polite instruction and a friendly offer. Next lesson: the basics of translation between Uzbek and English. Well done today.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: shahringiz bo‘ylab uch daqiqalik ekskursiyani yozib oling. Kamida uchta to‘xtash joyi, har biri uchun tarixiy fakt, muloyim ko‘rsatma va do‘stona taklif bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: tarjima asoslari. Bugun yaxshi ishladingiz.

homework_uz: Shahringiz bo‘ylab uch daqiqalik ekskursiyani yozib oling: kamida uchta to‘xtash joyi, har biri uchun tarixiy fakt, muloyim ko‘rsatma va do‘stona taklif. Zamonlarga va iliq ohangga e’tibor bering. Keyingi dars: tarjima asoslari.

quiz.q: Which is the most polite instruction to a group?
quiz.why_uz: Iltimos va could muloyim ohang beradi.

quiz.q: Which preposition? We meet ___ half past eleven.
What is the first step of service recovery in this lesson?
quiz.why_uz: Avval tinglash, keyin uzr va yechim.

options: I apologise for the delay. Let me check your order.
free of charge, paid by the hotel
Would you like to upgrade to a sea view room?

quiz.q: A guest says no to an offer. The best reply is:
options: Of course, no problem at all.
Are you sure? It is a great price.
Then you must pay the full price.
